messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: rosette.ai (dedicated cluster d-14) - elevated 502/504 and timeouts detected. Error rate > 15% over 3m across gateway nodes in us-west-2. Pager duty: @sre-oncall
pagerduty: Paging @sre-oncall, @Marta Runtime, @Jay Ops - escalation level 1
sre-oncall: I'm on it. Starting diagnostics. Can someone pull the per-tenant 5xx breakdown? @Ara CS please flag customer impact
Ara CS: Rosette reports higher latency on their endpoint /v1/generate, some 502s. Customer is on dedicated d-14. They'll be affected, but still serving some traffic.
Jay Ops: Looking at the gateway logs: host gw-03 and gw-04 showing lots of upstream resets to runtime-proxy and timeouts. tail logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:56:12Z gw-03 gateway ERROR upstream reset: code=504 path=/v1/generate tenant=rosette ai
2026-03-15T02:56:14Z gw-03 gateway WARN read timeout from runtime-proxy backend
```
Marta Runtime: Runtime metrics show KV cache evictions on node pool rp-d14-1, GPU utils spiking to 98% on pool gpool-a, and continuous batching queues growing. Possible noisy tenant starving KV and GPU.
Leo Eng: Can we confirm whether it's noisy neighbor from another tenant or Rosette's workload? Run per-tenant token rate and KV eviction correlation.
Jay Ops: Running quick query against monitoring:
```
# prometheus
sum by (tenant) (rate(model_inflight_requests_total[1m]))
# result top: tenant=streamline 7.8rps, tenant=rosette 2.1rps
sum by (tenant) (rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]))
# result top: tenant=streamline 180 evictions, tenant=rosette 5 evictions
```
Marta Runtime: That looks like tenant 'streamline' is causing the evictions. It's on the same dedicated cluster due to a pinning config mismatch. There was a recent deploy to pin streamline to d-14 earlier today (PR #412).
sre-oncall: Ok we have noisy neighbor. Immediate mitigations: 1) apply per-tenant runtime qcap for 'streamline' to reduce inflight 2) enable fallbacks for Rosette (route to overflow pool) 3) evict mis-pinned tenant if needed. Who can enact qcap?
Jay Ops: I can patch the routing policy. Applying throttle to tenant 'streamline' to 1 concurrent request.
```
# patch policy
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/tenants/streamline/policy -d '{"concurrency_limit":1}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```
ops-bot: Policy update accepted, concurrency_limit=1 for tenant=streamline
Marta Runtime: After throttle, GPU util on gpool-a dropped to 65% within 30s, KV eviction rate fell to ~12/min. Gateway 5xx sagged from 18% -> 4% in 2 min.
Ara CS: Rosette reports reduction in 502s, but they saw 2-3 minute window of degraded responses, possible lost requests. Apologized. They're asking for incident notes & ETA on full restoration.
sre-oncall: Good. For safety, open a canary route for Rosette to spill to backup dedicated pool d-14-bak.
```
runtime route update --tenant rosette --add-route cluster=d-14-bak,weight=30
```
ops-bot: Route update queued, applying... done.
Jay Ops: Confirming traffic shift: rosette traffic to d-14-bak now ~28% and healthy. No further 502s observed on that slice.
Marta Runtime: Root cause: mis-pinned tenant 'streamline' from a bad deploy, causing heavy KV churn and GPU saturation on d-14. Short-term mitigations executed: throttle noisy tenant + route spillover + increase per-cluster eviction threshold to avoid thrash.
sre-oncall: Actions remaining: 1) rollback or repin streamline to proper cluster 2) postmortem runbook updates to validate pinning changes in deploy PRs 3) customer communications to Rosette
Leo Eng: I've opened PR #418 to repin streamline to d-8 and am running a canary of the revert. Will monitor for 20m before rollback.
Ara CS: I'll send Rosette a message: brief timeline + apology + mention that we routed them to backup pool and throttled noisy tenant. Any SLA impact calc?
Marta Runtime: Preliminary impact: Rosette saw ~12% request failure rate for ~3m and elevated latencies 500-700ms for ~10m. No data loss; requests that failed will be retried by their client.
sre-oncall: Noting escalation: customer engaged. No breach of uptime SLA if this persists <30min but will follow up. I'll handoff to night oncall in 30m with summary.
pagerduty: Escalation: incident acknowledged. Severity S2 (customer-impacting but mitigated). Paging @Leo Eng for follow-up tomorrow.
Leo Eng: Acknowledged. Will finish repin and add pre-deploy validation for tenant->cluster pinning.
sre-oncall: Post-incident checklist: capture logs, snapshot metrics, link PRs: #412 (bad pin), #418 (repin), policy-change id=chg-782 (throttle). Draft postmortem template started.
ops-bot: Incident timeline logged: start=4081234567 end=4081234620 mitigations=[throttle-streamline, route-rosette-d14bak, repin-streamline-pr418]
Ara CS: Sent update to Rosette support: "We've mitigated the issue, routing you to a backup pool and throttling an offending tenant; full root cause & postmortem forthcoming."
Leo Eng: Repin completed and verified. GPU and KV metrics stable on d-14. Planning to revoke temporary throttle after 15m observation window.
sre-oncall: Revoking throttle now.
ops-bot: Policy update accepted, concurrency_limit removed for tenant=streamline
Marta Runtime: All clear: gateway 5xx back to baseline <0.5%, latency normal. Will keep monitoring for 1h.
sre-oncall: Handoff notes for night: summary, actions completed, files/PRs, customer notified. If any regression, page SRE oncall. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT RESOLVED (S2) - rossette.ai - elevated gateway 5xx mitigated. Refer to /wiki/incidents/4081234567 for details.
